Who you are buying from

Before you pay a stranger on the internet, this is who we are.

Who runs shrichakradhar.com?

Shri Chakradhar Publication Private Limited, a company registered in New Delhi under CIN U22213DL2019PTC352185. We are a publisher, not a reseller, and we print at our own press.

The founder is BK Sahni, who has worked with IGNOU distance-learning students since 2010 and is the credited author of the imprint’s help books and exam guides. You can verify the company on the Ministry of Corporate Affairs register using the CIN above, and you can walk into the Dwarka office during business hours.

Is Shri Chakradhar connected to IGNOU?

No. We are an independent publisher. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or an agent of Indira Gandhi National Open University.

Nothing bought here is issued by the university. Official IGNOU self-learning material comes free with your programme fee from your Regional Centre, and free digital copies are on eGyanKosh. What we sell is our own published material and our own written work. Anything about your admission, evaluation, grade card or degree goes to IGNOU directly.

Is it safe to pay on this website?

Payments run through a standard Indian payment gateway over an encrypted connection. We do not see or store your card details. If you would rather not pay online, message WhatsApp +91 93546 37830 and pay by UPI directly, or come to the Dwarka office and pay in cash.

A reasonable check before paying any IGNOU store: does it publish a company registration number, a physical address you could actually visit, and a phone number a human answers. We publish all three.

What is the difference between shrichakradhar.com and ignouproject.com?

shrichakradhar.com ignouproject.com

Go there for Buying books, assignments, guess papers, projects How IGNOU procedures work, deadlines, formats, status checks

We also publish ignoustudymaterial.com for study material by programme, ignouquestionpaper.com for question papers by subject code, and ignouguesspaper.com for guess papers.

Do you have a physical shop?

Yes. House No. 167, Ramphal Chowk Road, behind HDFC Bank, Sector 7 Dwarka, New Delhi 110077, open Monday to Saturday, 10:00 to 19:00. You can browse the printed titles, check the print quality with your own eyes before paying, and collect an order instead of paying for courier. The registered office is separately at Vishnu Garden, New Delhi 110018, and is not a retail counter.

How long have you been publishing?

Since 2010 for IGNOU students, with the private limited company incorporated in 2019. Over that period we have supported more than 5,00,000 students across MBA, MCom, MA, BA, BCom, BCA and the diploma and certificate ranges.

Can I see reviews before I buy?

Yes, and read the negative ones. Our Google reviews include complaints about print quality on older orders, and we would rather you see those and then read what we changed than discover them afterwards. Section 10 on this page sets out the current paper, binding and printing standards, and what to do if a copy arrives below them.

How to place an order

Four ways to order, and which one suits what.

How do I find the right product for my subject code?

Start from your programme, not from search. The catalogue is organised programme first, then subject code, because the same code can appear in more than one programme.

Pick your level from the menu, Master’s, Bachelor’s, Diploma or Certificate, then your programme, then your subject code. If you cannot find the code, it may be listed under a revised programme name, so send the code on WhatsApp and you will get a direct product link back.

What information should I send when ordering on WhatsApp?

  • Your programme, for example MCOM or BAG or MMPC
  • The exact subject codes you need
  • Medium, English or Hindi
  • Session, for the assignment and guess paper products
  • Format, soft copy or hard copy
  • Delivery PIN code, if you want a hard copy
  • Your deadline, if you have one

Sending those seven things in one message removes about six rounds of back and forth and gets you a price the same day.

Do I need to create an account?

For website orders, yes. An account lets you see your order history, track shipments and re-download digital files if you lose them. For WhatsApp orders, no account is needed and everything is delivered on WhatsApp.

Can I order without paying online?

Yes. Order on WhatsApp and pay by UPI, or come to the Dwarka office and pay in cash. Ask about cash on delivery when you order, since availability depends on the courier serving your PIN code and on the item.

Can I add to an order after placing it?

If it has not shipped, yes, and it usually saves you the second courier charge. Message WhatsApp with your order number and the extra subject codes. Once a hard-copy order has been handed to the courier it travels as it is, and additions ship separately.

Can I place a bulk or combo order?

Yes, and it is the normal way students buy. Full semester sets, all subject codes for a programme year, or combined orders for a study group are quoted together on WhatsApp, which usually beats adding items individually to the cart. Tell us the programme and the semester rather than listing every code, and we will build the set.

Can I order on behalf of another student?

Yes. Send their programme, subject codes and delivery address. For handwritten assignments we also need the medium. Nothing on this site needs the student’s enrolment number except project work, where it is used on the documentation.

How do I know my order was received?

Website orders generate an order number and a confirmation email. WhatsApp orders get a written confirmation with the item list and total before you pay. If you paid and have neither, message WhatsApp with the payment reference. Do not place a second order to be safe, because that usually ends with two deliveries.

Why is your book cheaper or costlier than another seller?

Price in this market tracks what is physically in the book. A thin stapled booklet of printed pages costs less to make than a properly bound guide with a heavier cover and a full unit-by-unit treatment. When comparing two IGNOU help books, compare the page count, the binding and whether the content is written or simply reproduced. Section 10 sets out what is in ours.

Do you offer student discounts or offers?

Seasonal offers run before each June and December examination cycle and around assignment cut-off periods, and bulk orders are quoted below single-item pricing. There is no separate student card scheme, since effectively every customer is a student.

My payment failed but money left my account. What now?

Failed gateway transactions are normally auto-reversed by your bank within three to seven working days without anyone doing anything. Send the payment reference on WhatsApp and we will confirm from our side whether the order registered. Do not re-pay until that is confirmed.

Can I pay partly now and partly later?

For project work, yes. Longer project engagements are commonly split between an advance at the start and the balance on delivery. For catalogue products, payment is full and upfront, because they ship immediately.

Which parts of India do you ship to?

Yes, PAN India, including North East states, Jammu and Kashmir, and island territories, though remote PIN codes take longer and occasionally attract a surcharge which is shown before you pay. Digital items reach anywhere with internet, including students outside India.

How do I track my order?

A tracking number is shared on WhatsApp when your parcel is handed to the courier, and website orders also show tracking in the account area. If tracking has not moved for three working days, message us rather than waiting: a parcel stuck at a hub gets released when the shipper raises it, not when the recipient does.

Can I get urgent or express delivery?

Ask before ordering, not after. For printed items already in stock we can prioritise dispatch and use a faster courier service at extra cost. For handwritten assignments the writing time is the constraint, not the courier, so genuinely urgent requests need to be assessed honestly. We would rather tell you it is not achievable than take the order and miss your cut-off.

Can I collect from your office instead?

Yes, and it removes both the courier charge and the transit risk. Order on WhatsApp, tell us you will collect, and pick up from the Dwarka office Monday to Saturday, 10:00 to 19:00. Message before travelling so the order is packed and waiting.

My parcel has not arrived. What should I do?

  2. If it shows delivered but you did not receive it, check with neighbours and your building security, which resolves most of these
  3. If it has not moved for three working days, send us the order number and we raise it with the courier
  4. If the courier confirms loss, we resend at our cost

Keep the tracking number until the parcel is in your hands.

What if I gave the wrong address?

Tell us immediately. Before dispatch it is a simple correction. After dispatch, redirection depends on the courier and is not always possible, and a parcel returned to us can be resent once you pay the second courier charge. Check the PIN code carefully at checkout; it causes more failed deliveries than anything else.

Do you ship outside India?

Digital items yes, anywhere. Printed books and handwritten copies, no. IGNOU has learners across the Gulf, Southeast Asia and Africa, and for them the practical route is soft copies by WhatsApp and email.

Soft copy or hard copy: which to choose

The first decision on most of our products, and the one most often got wrong.

What is the difference between soft copy and hard copy?

A soft copy is a PDF delivered to your WhatsApp or email within hours. A hard copy is a physical printed and bound item couriered to your address.

Most of our catalogue exists in both. The right choice depends on what you are going to do with it: read and revise from it, or hand it in.

Which should I buy for each product?

Product Usually best as Why
Guess papers Soft copy You need them in the last days before an exam, and speed beats paper
Previous year question papers Soft copy, hard copy for heavy users Solve them on screen or print only the ones you need
Help books and study guides Hard copy You read these for weeks; screen reading a full guide is punishing
Solved assignments Soft copy They are reference for writing your own answers, not something you hand in
Handwritten assignments Hard copy The physical handwritten sheets are the entire point
Readymade projects Soft copy You will be adapting it, so you need an editable reference

Is the soft copy cheaper?

Yes, usually noticeably, because there is no paper, no printing, no binding and no courier. If budget is the constraint and you have access to a printer, buying the soft copy and printing only what you need is the cheapest route.

Can I print the soft copy myself?

Yes, for your own use. What is not permitted is redistributing it, uploading it to a file-sharing site or reselling it. These are published works and the files are watermarked to the buyer.

In what format do soft copies arrive?

PDF, readable on any phone, tablet or computer without special software. Handwritten scans arrive as PDF too. If a file will not open, message us: it is almost always an incomplete download rather than a corrupt file.

Can I upgrade from soft copy to hard copy later?

Yes. Message WhatsApp with your original order number and pay the difference plus courier. It works out slightly more than buying the hard copy at the start, so if you think you will want paper, take paper first.

Which does IGNOU actually accept?

Neither, as a submission. That is worth being blunt about.

Guess papers, question papers and help books are study material, not submissions, so the format is purely your preference. Assignments and projects are submitted in whatever form your study centre or Regional Centre requires, and that is a rule set by them, not by us. Ask your study centre whether it takes handwritten sheets, printed sheets or an upload, then buy the format that matches.

Buying IGNOU books and help books

Which edition, which medium, and how our books differ from the university’s material.

What exactly is inside a help book I buy here?

An A5 printed guide, written by us, that condenses a course into unit-by-unit revision material with previous-year question mapping. It is not a copy of IGNOU’s blocks and it is not a photocopied booklet.

Each title states its page count, its subject codes and its medium on the product page. Open a product page before ordering and check those three things: they tell you more about what you are buying than any description does. Section 10 covers the paper, printing and binding specification.

What a help book is not is a replacement for the university’s own material, which you already have free. Buy one to revise faster, not to skip the blocks.

Should I buy your books if the official material is free?

Only if the compression is worth money to you. If you have a full session ahead and time to read the blocks, you may not need a guide at all. If you are three weeks from the examination with six papers, a unit-by-unit guide with question coverage is the difference between revising and panicking. We would rather you buy the right thing than everything.

How do I know which book covers my subject code?

Every title is listed against its subject codes, and the product page names them explicitly. Some titles cover several codes for a semester, which is why the MCom semester guides are sold as one book per semester rather than one per paper. If your code is not listed anywhere, send it on WhatsApp before ordering something adjacent.

Are your books available in Hindi?

Yes, for most programmes, and the Hindi editions are separately written rather than translated.

This matters more than it sounds. IGNOU’s Hindi-medium papers use their own established terminology, and a machine-translated commerce or psychology guide teaches vocabulary the examiner will not recognise. Choose the medium you will answer in, not the one you read faster.

How do I know I am buying the current edition?

Product pages state the edition. Syllabus revisions happen and an old edition genuinely does become the wrong book, so if you are ordering for a programme that changed recently, confirm on WhatsApp. If you receive a superseded edition because our listing was stale, that is our error and we replace it.

Do you sell books for the new BAM, BSCM and online programmes?

Yes. The catalogue covers the newer BAM and BSCM structures, the online variants such as BCAOL, MCOMOL, MEGOL, BSWOL and their siblings, alongside the older BAG, BCOMG and BSCG ranges. Online-mode programmes often share subject codes with the ODL version, so check the code rather than the programme name.

Do you have books for every programme?

For most, not for all. Coverage is deepest where student numbers are highest: MBA and MMPC, MCom, BAG, BCOMG, BSCG, BCA, MCA, MAPC, MSW, MEG, MHD, MPS, MAH, MEC, MPA, MSO, MARD, MTTM, MLIS, MAEDU and the main diploma and certificate ranges. Very small programmes may have guess papers and solved assignments but no printed guide.

What is a Last Minute Exam Guide?

A printed A5 guide built for the fortnight before the examination: unit-by-unit coverage in syllabus order, previous-year question mapping, and answer structure for the sections carrying the most marks. It is deliberately not a textbook. If you buy one three months out, you have bought the wrong product.

Do you sell IGNOU’s own official books?

No, and be careful of anyone who says they do. The university issues its self-learning material to enrolled students free through the Regional Centre, and free digital copies are on eGyanKosh. Everything we sell is our own published work.

Can I buy your books on Amazon instead?

Selected titles, yes, under the Shri Chakradhar imprint. Amazon suits you if you want its delivery network and returns process. Buying direct suits you if you want a title Amazon does not carry, a Hindi edition, a bulk semester set, or a price without the marketplace margin.

Buying solved and handwritten assignments

Two different products that students constantly confuse before ordering.

Solved assignment or handwritten assignment: which product do I need?

A solved assignment is a typed answer set you read and learn from. A handwritten assignment is physical sheets written out by hand. They are different products at different prices and they solve different problems.

If you are unsure, buy the solved set first. It is cheaper, it arrives today, and you can still order handwriting later if you run out of time.

Which session’s edition should I order?

The current one for your subject code, which is not necessarily the year you enrolled.

IGNOU releases fresh assignment question papers each session and study centres check answers against the current paper. Ordering an older edition because it matches your admission year is the most common ordering mistake we see. Tell us your subject code and we will confirm which edition is live before you pay.

Is the solved assignment priced per subject or per programme?

Per subject code. Students normally order the four to eight codes they are sitting that session rather than a whole programme. Full-semester sets are quoted together on WhatsApp and come out lower than adding codes one by one to the cart.

Do you have a printed solved assignment book rather than PDFs?

Yes. There is a hard-copy solved assignment book covering all programmes and courses for any session, sold as a single printed volume, alongside the per-subject soft copies. It suits students who want everything for a programme in one place on paper. The per-subject PDF suits students who need three codes tomorrow.

What exactly do I get for Rs 320 on a handwritten assignment?

  • The full handwritten answer set for one subject code, on ruled A4
  • A completed front page in your programme’s format, at no extra cost
  • Paper, stationery and writing charges
  • Courier anywhere in India with a tracking number

The list price is Rs 350 and the live price is Rs 320. There is no separate cover-page charge and no standard delivery surcharge.

What can I see before I pay?

For handwriting, a photo of the actual hand on WhatsApp. For printed books, photographs of the interior pages. For projects, a relevant sample.

Ask for it every time, with us or with anyone else. Handwriting and print quality are the two things you cannot judge from a listing, and a seller unwilling to show you either before payment is asking you to buy blind.

Is my handwritten copy written only for me?

Yes. Each order is written out individually rather than photocopied from a master, and one writer completes all the subject codes in a single student’s order so the hand stays consistent across your whole submission.

This is why we do not sell cheap shared handwritten PDFs. Those circulate in identical handwriting across thousands of submissions, and study centres do notice.

Can I get a scanned PDF of the handwritten copy?

Yes, where your Regional Centre accepts digital submission. The scan is made from the copy written for you and is not resold to anyone else. Say at the time of ordering whether you need the scan, the physical sheets, or both.

Which programmes can you write handwritten copies for?

All the major ones: MBA and the MMPC codes, MCom with MCO and IBO, BAG, BCOMG, BSCG, BCA with BCS and BCSL, MCA with MCS, the MA streams, MAPC, MSW, MLIS, MARD, MAEDU, MTTM, MPA, MAEC, MASO, MAPS, MAHI, MGPS, MAANY, plus the diploma and certificate ranges. Send your codes on WhatsApp for confirmation.

Do you write Hindi-medium handwritten copies?

Yes, and they are written by writers who work in Devanagari regularly. A Hindi answer written by an English-medium hand reads laboured and slows an evaluator down. State the medium when you order, because it determines which writer takes the job.

How many subject codes should I order at once?

Order the full set you are submitting this session in one go. It is cheaper on courier, the handwriting stays consistent across every subject, and it avoids the situation where two codes arrive after your cut-off. Ordering piecemeal across three weeks is how students end up paying three courier charges.

When should I place a handwritten order to be safe?

At least three weeks before your study centre cut-off. Writing takes 7 to 9 working days including courier under normal load, and the fortnight before every deadline is when writer capacity across the entire market runs out. Ordering early costs the same and removes the risk.

What if IGNOU changes the question paper after I order?

Tell us as soon as you know. If the work has not started we switch to the new paper at no charge. If it is part written we will discuss what is salvageable honestly rather than deliver you a set answering questions nobody asked.

Buying guess papers and solved question papers

Two Rs 49 products, and what each one can and cannot do for you.

How are these delivered?

As PDF, the same day you pay, on WhatsApp or email. There is no courier and no delivery charge. If you want them on paper, print the PDF or ask about the printed compilations.

Which session’s guess paper should I buy?

The edition prepared for your upcoming examination cycle, June or December. Guess papers are rebuilt before each cycle because the pattern analysis is redone against the newest paper. An old edition is not useless, but you are buying last cycle’s prioritisation.

How much of the paper will the guess paper actually cover?

A meaningful share on most subjects, and less on subjects whose syllabus changed recently. Anyone quoting you a fixed percentage across all subjects is inventing it.

Coverage works because IGNOU reuses questions heavily from a finite bank per course, so pattern analysis is genuinely predictive. It works less well where a code was revised in the last year or two and there is little usable history behind it. If your code is newly revised, we will say so rather than sell you thin analysis.

Are guess papers available for my programme?

Coverage is broad across Master’s, Bachelor’s, diploma and certificate programmes. MBA and MMPC, MCom, MARD, MTTM, MEG, MHD, MEC, MPS, MPA, MSO, MAPC, MAAN, MLIS, MSW, MAEDU, MSCDFSM, MGPS, MADVS and dozens more on the Master’s side, and BAG, BCOMG, BSCG, BCA, BLIS, BSW, BTS, B.Ed and the honours streams on the Bachelor’s side. Diploma and certificate coverage includes DNHE, DECE, DTS, DEVMT, PGDDM, PGDRD, PGDHE, PGDET, PGDEMA, PGDIBO and others.

Do you have these in Hindi?

Yes, for programmes IGNOU offers in Hindi medium. Hindi editions use the terminology the Hindi paper actually uses rather than translating an English answer, which matters because a translated answer often misses the expected vocabulary entirely.

Can I buy a bundle for all my subjects?

Yes, and it is the sensible way. Send the full code list on WhatsApp and you get a bundle price rather than paying Rs 49 six times. Full-semester bundles are the most common order in this category.

My subject code is not in the catalogue. Can you still supply it?

Often. The published catalogue covers high-demand codes, and we compile others on request where enough past-paper history exists. Send the code and we will tell you plainly whether we can build something useful or whether the history is too thin to be worth your money.

Can I share the PDF with my classmates?

No. Files are watermarked to the buyer and these are published works. Group buying is fine and we will quote a bundle for a study group, but redistributing or uploading a file is not.

Buying IGNOU projects: readymade or customized

The most important decision on this site, and the one where the wrong choice costs the most.

What are the three project options here?

Option What it is Where
Readymade, soft copy A completed sample project for a programme, delivered as an editable file This store
Readymade, hard copy The same, printed and bound This store
Customized A project written to your own topic, with guidance through approval Arranged via ignouproject.com

Which one should I actually buy?

Buy readymade if you want a model to see how a finished project for your programme is built. Buy customized if this is the project you are going to submit.

The reason is simple arithmetic. A readymade project for a popular programme is bought by a lot of students. If several of them submit it, the similarity is visible to an evaluator. Readymade exists to show you structure, chapter flow, methodology and formatting. Customized exists to be yours.

Can I submit a readymade project as it is?

No, and we would rather lose the sale than let you find that out at evaluation.

High similarity is one of the standard grounds for project rejection, and a sample circulating widely is exactly what similarity checking is designed to catch. Use a readymade project as a reference: study how the objectives are framed, how the methodology is justified, how the data chapter is organised, then write your own against your own topic.

What is included in a readymade project?

The complete project report for the stated programme and course code, with the standard front matter, chapters, bibliography and annexures, plus the synopsis where the programme uses one. The hard-copy version arrives printed and bound. Product pages state the programme, the course code and the format.

Which programmes have readymade projects?

A wide range across both soft copy and hard copy: MBA including MMPP-1 and the Marketing, Finance, HR, Operations and Banking specialisations, MCom, MAPC with MPCE-16, MPCE-26 and MPCE-36, MSW, MAEDU, MARD, MTTM, MLIS, MSCDFSM, MSCENV, MSCIS, MSCCFT, MEC, MPA, MPS, MADE, BTS with PTS-4, PTS-5 and PTS-6, BAPCH, BSCANH, BAVTM, DECE, DNHE, DTS, DPLAD, DIPP, AHE, AMT, and the PGDRD, PGDDM, PGDHE, PGDEMA, PGDIS, PGDCJ, PGDFSQM, PGDUPDL, PGCPP and certificate ranges.

How does a customized project work?

It runs as a guided engagement rather than a purchase: topic selection, synopsis written to your programme’s proforma, revisions free of charge until the synopsis is approved, then the full report written to the approved synopsis. It is quoted per case because a 2-credit project and a 12-credit dissertation are not the same work. Start it on WhatsApp or at ignouproject.com.

What does a customized project cost?

Quoted per case, based on programme, credit weight and whether primary data collection and statistical analysis are involved. You get scope and price in writing before anything begins, and nothing is added afterwards. Readymade projects are fixed-price and listed on their product pages.

Can you also arrange a project guide?

Yes, Rs 1,000, added to a synopsis order, for students who cannot find an eligible supervisor through their Study Centre or Regional Centre. You receive the guide’s signed biodata in IGNOU format and their signature on the approval proforma and annexures, by Speed Post or collected from the Dwarka office, and you are put in contact with the guide. The eligibility rules and what is deliberately excluded are set out on the project guide section at ignouproject.com.

How long does a customized project take?

The synopsis is usually ready within a few days of the brief being agreed. The report takes longer and depends on credit weight and data collection. The part nobody can compress is IGNOU’s own approval window on the synopsis, which runs roughly four to eight weeks, so work backwards from your Regional Centre deadline with that included.

Do you print and bind a project I wrote myself?

Yes. Bring or send the file and we print and bind it at our own press: spiral, soft or hard bound, to the page size and margins your programme prescribes, with cover printing. This is a common walk-in job at the Dwarka office in the weeks before submission.

Print quality, paper and binding standards

Read this section before ordering anything printed. It also answers our own bad reviews directly.

What paper and binding do your printed books use?

Titles are printed A5 on white book paper with a printed card cover, and bound rather than stapled. Every product page states the page count, and the page count is the honest measure of what you are buying. A guide that condenses a full course into a genuinely useful revision text runs to a real number of pages, and that number is published rather than hidden.

Some of your older reviews complain about print quality. What happened?

Fair criticism on some older orders, and we would rather address it than pretend it is not there.

Complaints on our Google listing describe faint or blurred printing and books that felt like stapled printouts. Those are legitimate descriptions of what some customers received. Printing now runs on our own press rather than through third-party job work, which is what put quality inside our control instead of someone else’s.

If you receive a copy with faint printing, missing pages, or binding that fails, photograph it and send the photos on WhatsApp with your order number. We replace it. That is a straightforward commitment and it costs you nothing to hold us to it.

Why do some titles look thin for the price?

Because condensing is the product. A last-minute exam guide is deliberately shorter than the university’s blocks, and its value is the selection and the question mapping rather than the paper weight. What is not acceptable is a thin book that is thin because the content was skipped, and page count plus the subject codes covered are published on each product page so you can judge which one you are looking at before paying.

Can I see the inside pages before ordering?

Yes. Ask on WhatsApp and we photograph the interior pages of the exact title. For a book you are going to read for weeks, spending two minutes on this is worth it.

Can I inspect books at your shop?

Yes, and it is the best way if you are in Delhi. Come to the Dwarka office during opening hours, handle the actual book, read a few pages, then decide. Nothing on a website tells you as much as thirty seconds with the physical copy.

Is the content original or copied from IGNOU material?

Written by us and credited to BK Sahni. The subject matter necessarily follows IGNOU’s syllabus, because that is what you are being examined on, but the text is our own writing rather than reproduced university blocks. If you want the university’s own blocks, they are free on eGyanKosh and there is no reason to pay anyone for them.

How current is the content?

Titles are revised against syllabus changes and refreshed around the June and December examination cycles. Product pages state the edition. If a programme has just been revised and we have not caught up, we will tell you rather than sell you the superseded edition.

What if I receive the wrong book?

Photograph the cover and the order slip and send both on WhatsApp. A wrong item is our error, and we send the correct title and arrange collection of the wrong one at our cost. Do not post it back before telling us, because unannounced returns are hard to match to an order.

Returns, refunds and problems with an order

The policy in plain terms, including the parts that are not in your favour.

Can I return a printed item?

Yes, if it arrives damaged, misprinted, incomplete or is the wrong title. Report within 48 hours of delivery with photographs and your order number, and we replace it or refund it. Buyer’s remorse on a correctly supplied book is harder, because a book that has been in transit and handled cannot go back into stock, so choose carefully or inspect at the shop first.

Can I get a refund on a digital file?

Generally no, once the file has been delivered, for the obvious reason that it cannot be returned.

This is standard for digital goods and every seller in this category applies it. Where we do refund is when the file is unreadable, is the wrong subject code, or is materially not what the product page described. Check the code carefully before paying, and ask questions first rather than after.

Can I cancel an order?

Before dispatch, yes, with a full refund. After dispatch, the courier is already paid and in motion, so cancellation becomes a return. For handwritten assignments, cancellation is possible before writing begins; once a writer has started, part-completed work has a real cost and we will discuss it case by case.

How long does a refund take?

Approved refunds are processed within two to three working days and reach your bank or UPI account in a further three to seven working days depending on your bank. Refunds go back to the original payment method. If you paid by UPI and have since closed that account, tell us before the refund is issued.

My order arrived incomplete. What do I do?

Photograph everything you received including the packaging, and send it with your order number. Multi-item orders occasionally ship in more than one parcel, so we check first whether the rest is in transit. If something is genuinely missing we send it at our cost.

What if the item does not match the product page?

That is on us. Send the order number and describe the difference. If the listing was wrong, you get the correct item or a full refund, your choice. Listing errors happen on a catalogue this size, and the fix is ours to make rather than yours to absorb.

What is not covered?

  • Marks or grades. Nothing anyone sells can influence what an evaluator awards
  • Rejection of work you submitted, where you submitted a readymade sample as your own
  • Delays caused by a wrong or incomplete delivery address
  • Courier delays outside our control, though we chase them and resend genuinely lost parcels
  • Ordering the wrong subject code when the code you sent was the one supplied

Stating these plainly is better than burying them. Most disputes in this industry come from expectations nobody wrote down.

How do I escalate if I am not satisfied?

Message WhatsApp +91 93546 37830 and ask for the owner, or email sales@shrichakradhar.com with your order number in the subject line. You can also walk into the Dwarka office. If a complaint has gone unanswered, say so directly and it will be looked at, because an unresolved complaint costs us more in public than it does to fix.

Your account, downloads and support

Getting back to your files and getting hold of a human.

Do I need an account to buy?

For website orders, yes, and it is worth having: order history, shipment tracking and re-downloads all live there. For WhatsApp orders, no account is needed and everything arrives on WhatsApp.

I lost my PDF. Can I download it again?

Yes. Website purchases can be re-downloaded from your account. For files sent on WhatsApp, message us with the order number or the payment reference and we resend. There is no charge for resending a file you already bought.

Can I change my delivery address after ordering?

Before dispatch, yes, immediately and at no cost. After dispatch it depends on the courier and is often not possible. Message as soon as you notice, because the window is short.

How do I find my order number?

It is in your confirmation email and in your account order history for website purchases. For WhatsApp orders, scroll back to the confirmation message. If you cannot find either, send the payment reference or the UPI transaction ID and we will locate the order.

What are your support hours?

Monday to Saturday, 10:00 to 19:00, on WhatsApp, phone and at the Dwarka office. Messages sent outside those hours are answered the next working morning. During assignment cut-off weeks and the run-up to term-end examinations, response times stretch, which is another reason to order early.

How quickly will someone reply?

WhatsApp within working hours, usually the same hour. Email within one working day. If something is genuinely urgent, WhatsApp rather than email, and say what your deadline is in the first message.

Do you keep my personal details private?

Your name, address, contact number and programme details are used to fulfil and dispatch your order and nothing else. We do not sell or share customer records. For project work, your enrolment number and topic are handled the same way, and a project written for you is never resold to another student.

Can I get help choosing what to buy?

Yes, and it costs nothing. Send your programme, your subject codes and how far you are from your examination or deadline.

You will get a recommendation, and sometimes that recommendation is to buy less than you were planning. A student six weeks out needs previous year papers, not a guess paper. A student who has read the blocks may not need a help book at all. We would rather sell you the right one thing than the wrong four.

Submitting your IGNOU assignments correctly and on time is crucial for success. IGNOU requires every student to submit course assignments before the Term-End Exam (TEE) for each session. This comprehensive guide explains how to submit IGNOU assignments, the IGNOU assignment submission process (both offline and online), important deadlines for June and December exams, assignment format guidelines, and answers to common queries. By following these instructions, you can avoid delays, ensure your work is accepted, and secure the assignment marks that count towards your final result.

Why is assignment submission important? In IGNOU’s evaluation system, assignments typically carry 30% weightage of your course marks, while term-end exams carry 70%. More importantly, you cannot appear for the TEE unless you submit the assignments for that course. Timely submission ensures your marks are added to your grade card and keeps your studies on track. Whether you are pursuing IGNOU BA, MA, B.Com, M.Com, MBA, B.Ed, or any other program, the assignment submission process is essentially the same for all courses and sessions. Below, we break down the steps and guidelines to help you through the IGNOU assignment submission process.

Download IGNOU Solved Assignment for all IGNOU’s Courses (Latest Session) in Soft-Copy (PDF): Click Here

  • FAQs in IGNOU Assignment Submission

IGNOU Assignment Submission Deadlines and Schedule

Each academic session has a cut-off date by which assignments must be submitted. Missing the IGNOU assignment last date can have serious consequences, so it’s important to know the schedule for your program:

  • For June Term-End Exam (TEE) – If you enrolled in the January session, your assignments are usually due by 31st March for the June TEE. In many cases, this deadline is extended into April or even May for the current session. For example, in some recent years the last date was extended to mid-May. Always verify the exact date announced for that year, as IGNOU often issues extensions or adjustments.
  • For December Term-End Exam (TEE) – If you enrolled in the July session, the typical due date is 30th September for the December TEE. This deadline too may be extended to October or November depending on the circumstances. Keep an eye on official updates for any assignment deadline extended notifications.

These are general timelines; always check the latest official announcement from IGNOU for the exact last date each semester, since it can vary by session or be revised. It’s best not to wait until the very last day. Submit your work early so that if any issues arise (like technical problems with online submission or delays in postal delivery), you have time to resolve them. Early submission also means your IGNOU assignment submission status and marks are more likely to be updated in the system by the time results are compiled.

What happens if you miss the deadline? If you fail to submit by the last date (and any extended date), your assignment may not be accepted for that TEE cycle. This means your assignment marks will not be added for that term, and you may not be allowed to sit for the exam for that course. You would then have to submit the assignment in the next session, which delays your progress by 6 months or more. Missing the deadline can thus postpone your graduation. In short, never ignore the submission dates – plan to finish your assignments well in advance.

IGNOU Assignment Format and Guidelines

Before you submit, you must prepare your assignment answers in the proper format following IGNOU’s guidelines. Adhering to the official IGNOU assignment guidelines will ensure your work is accepted without any issues. Important points to remember include the following:

  • Handwritten or Typed? IGNOU assignments must be handwritten. Typed or printed submissions are not accepted under standard guidelines. Write your answers neatly on A4 size ruled paper. Use blue or black ink (avoid red or other colors which are reserved for examiners). Clear handwriting is important for the evaluator to read your responses. If your handwriting is poor, take your time to write more legibly.
  • Follow the Assignment Instructions: Each assignment question usually comes with specific instructions or a word limit. For example, a question might suggest writing the answer in 500 words. Adhere to these IGNOU assignment word limit suggestions as closely as possible. If no word count is given, answer comprehensively but concisely, focusing on the question’s requirements. Stay on topic and avoid unnecessary filler content.
  • Numbering and Order: Write the answers in the same order as the questions. Clearly number each answer with the corresponding question number. Do not copy the answers from peers or sources – plagiarism can lead to your IGNOU assignment being rejected or getting a zero. Always use your own words and understanding. Once you complete writing, number the pages sequentially (1, 2, 3, …) and secure them together (by stapling or tying). This ensures nothing is lost and the evaluator can follow your work easily.
  • IGNOU Assignment Cover Page (Front Page): The first page of each assignment answer set should be a cover page with essential details. This standard IGNOU assignment cover page format helps identify your work. Include the following information on the front page (you may use a printed proforma given by your study centre or neatly handwrite these details):
    • Student NameEnrollment NumberProgram Title and Code (e.g., Bachelor of Arts – BA, Master of Commerce – MCOM, etc.)Course Code & Course Title (e.g., ECO-01 for Economics course, etc.)Assignment Code (as given in the assignment question booklet, e.g., MMPP-01/TMA/2025)Session (e.g., January 2025 or July 2025 for which you are submitting)Study Centre Code and Name (the code or name of your allotted study centre)Regional Centre (name of your IGNOU regional centre)Date of SubmissionStudent’s Contact Details (some forms include your address, email, and phone number on the cover page)
    Make sure the cover page is filled out for each course’s assignment. If you have multiple courses, each assignment should have its own cover sheet. You can prepare a simple cover page yourself or obtain a format/template from the IGNOU website or your study centre. The assignment will not be accepted without this front page information, so double-check that it’s complete and accurate.
  • Formatting Your Answers: Use a clean layout. Leave a margin on the left side of each page (about an inch) – this space is often used by evaluators to write marks or remarks. Write on one side of the page if possible (unless instructed otherwise) to keep it neat. After finishing all answers, it’s a good idea to compile them in a light file or tie them together. A well-organized assignment (with pages in order and a proper cover page) creates a good impression and prevents pages from getting lost.
  • Scanning and Copy for Records: It’s wise to keep a personal copy of your completed assignments. Before submission, scan your handwritten pages into a PDF or take clear photos of each page and compile them. This way, if the submitted assignment is misplaced or any dispute arises, you have proof and backup. Scanning is also necessary if you will be submitting online (explained below). Ensure the scanned PDF is clear and readable – check that all pages are included and in correct order.

By following these IGNOU assignment instructions on format, you minimize the risk of rejection due to technicalities. Preparing the assignment correctly is as important as the content of your answers. Now that the assignment is ready, let’s look at where and how to submit it.

Must Read: IGNOU Assignment Sample

IGNOU Offline Assignment Submission (At Study Centre)

For most traditional Open and Distance Learning students, the standard method is to submit a hard copy of the assignment at your designated study centre. This is often referred to as offline submission. Here is the IGNOU assignment submission process for offline mode:

  1. Complete the Assignment – Ensure you have written all answers by hand and attached the cover page with all required details for each course assignment. Double-check that you’ve included everything as per the guidelines (as explained above).
  2. Visit Your Study Centre – Find out the working hours and days of your IGNOU study centre (usually they are open on weekdays and sometimes weekends during specific hours). It’s best to go well before the last date to avoid crowds or any last-minute issues. If you are unsure where to submit or looking for “IGNOU assignment submission near me”, remember that you should submit it to the study centre assigned to you (the one associated with your enrollment, typically near your location or chosen during admission). Do not submit assignments to the Regional Centre or any other office unless explicitly instructed; the study centre is the primary point for assignment submissions.
  3. Submit to the Coordinator/Instructor – At the centre, inform the staff that you are there to submit assignments. Typically, the Study Centre has a Coordinator or Programme In-Charge who collects assignments, or there may be a designated drop box or counter. Hand over your neatly compiled assignment to the authorized person. If you have assignments for multiple courses, usually you submit them all together, but ensure each is separate with its cover page.
  4. Collect Acknowledgement Receipt – After handing in the assignments, obtain an acknowledgement. This could be a stamped and signed receipt, or a signature on a submission form or on a copy of your cover page. The IGNOU assignment acknowledgement receipt is proof that you submitted your work on a certain date. It typically has your enrollment number, course codes, submission date, and an official stamp/signature. Do not leave without this receipt. Keep it safe until your assignment marks are updated, in case any issue arises about submission.
  5. Submission by Post (if needed) – IGNOU generally expects in-person submission at the study centre. However, if you live far from the centre or cannot travel, some students opt to send assignments by post or courier. If doing so, use a reliable postal service and address it to The Coordinator of your Study Centre, mentioning your enrolment details and course codes. It’s crucial to send well before the deadline. After mailing, you should ideally call the study centre to confirm they received your package. Always keep a dispatch receipt. Note that sending by post is riskier (if lost or delayed), so do this only if you have no alternative or if your regional guidelines allow postal submission.

Tips: Even for offline submissions, keep a digital copy (scanned PDF) of your assignment as backup. Occasionally, assignments can get misplaced at the centre. If the study centre later reports they don’t have your assignment on record, you can quickly provide the digital copy or resubmit if necessary. Also, if your region eventually asks for an online copy (some Regional Centres have asked students to email the assignments in addition to physical submission to maintain records), having a scanned version ready will save you time.

IGNOU Online Assignment Submission (Via Portal or Email)

IGNOU introduced online assignment submission options, especially during recent years when physical movement was limited. Some programs (particularly online mode programs) and certain Regional Centres allow or require assignments to be submitted online. IGNOU online assignment submission can be done through different channels depending on instructions: an online portal/link, Google Forms, or email. Always refer to your Regional Centre’s latest guidelines to know the acceptable online method for your course. Below is a general outline of the IGNOU assignment upload process:

  1. Check Online Submission Availability – First, confirm if your Regional Centre or program is accepting assignments online. Visit your IGNOU Regional Centre’s website or look for notifications about assignment submission for the current session. Often, regional centres have a section like “Online Assignment Submission for TEE (June/December)” which provides a link or an email address for uploading assignments. There might be an IGNOU assignment submission portal specific to that region or a Google Form link. For example, some centers provide a Google Form where you fill in your details and attach the files, while others ask you to email the PDFs to a designated email ID.
  2. Scan and Prepare PDF Files – If you haven’t already, scan your handwritten assignment pages into PDF format. Ensure each course’s assignment is in a separate PDF file. Follow any file size guidelines provided – typically try to keep each file size reasonably small (for instance, under 5 or 10 MB) so it’s easy to upload or email. You can use scanner apps on your phone or a physical scanner to create clear PDF files. Name the PDF files appropriately as instructed (if no specific instruction, a good practice is to name each file as EnrollmentNumber_CourseCode.pdf. E.g., 1234567890_MS01.pdf for course code MS-01).
  3. Upload via Portal/Link – If your RC has provided an online portal or form, navigate to that IGNOU assignment submission link. It will usually ask for details like your name, enrollment number, program, course code, etc. Fill in all required fields carefully. Then attach the corresponding PDF file for each course as directed. Double-check you attached the correct file for each course before final submission. Submit the form and wait for a confirmation message on-screen that it was successful. Take a screenshot of the confirmation or note any reference number given.
  4. Submission by Email – If the instruction is to email your assignments, compose a neat email to the given official email address (for example, a Regional Centre’s email). In the subject line, include “Assignment Submission , , ” or any format they suggest. In the email body, provide your details (Name, Enrollment, Program, Study Centre, Course codes submitted, etc.). Attach the PDF files of your assignments. It’s often recommended to send one email with all attachments if they are going to the same recipient, unless asked to send separately. After sending, you should get either an automated reply or you can request a confirmation. If you don’t get any acknowledgement in a few days, follow up with the office to ensure they received your email.
  5. Confirmation and Receipt – For online submissions, an official confirmation could be an email reply, an auto-generated receipt, or simply the screenshot of the submission page saying “success”. Keep this proof just like you would keep a physical receipt. Some portals also allow you to check the IGNOU assignment submission status by logging in later – for instance, an LMS (Learning Management System) might show if your assignment file was received or graded. Save any confirmation emails safely.

Important: Even if online submission is available, always adhere to the specific instructions given by your Regional/Study Centre. Some regional centres during certain sessions required both online and offline submission (to be safe). Others strictly want only one mode. Also, different regions had different deadlines or links; there isn’t one central “IGNOU assignment submission portal” for all – it varies by region or school. Therefore, use the official communication you have (like email notices, SMS from IGNOU, or announcements on ignou.ac.in and regional websites) as your primary guide.

Online submission can be very convenient as you can do it from home. Just be sure to scan your files properly (clear images, correct orientation) and send/upload well before the deadline to avoid last-minute technical glitches (website overload, slow uploads, etc.). After submitting online, you should still verify later that your assignment was marked as received/accepted in the system or with your study centre.

After IGNOU Assignment Submission: Checking Status and Resolving Issues

Once you have submitted your assignments (whether offline or online), there are a few things to follow up on:

  • Grade Card Update: IGNOU assignments are evaluated by tutors at the study centre, and the marks are then sent to the university to be updated in your grade card. It can take several weeks (or even a couple of months) after submission for the marks to appear, often around or after the TEE results are declared. You can check your grade card on the official IGNOU site by entering your enrollment number to see if your assignment marks are reflected.
  • Assignment Submission Status: In some cases, especially for online programs or if your region provided tracking, you might be able to see a status like “Received” or “Not Received” for your assignments in the student portal. Most traditional students rely on the grade card updates. If IGNOU assignment marks are not reflecting in the grade card even after the TEE results (and you submitted on time), it could mean either the assignment was not received/recorded properly or the evaluation is delayed.
  • What to do if not updated? If you find that your IGNOU assignment is not updated or the status shows “Not found” even though you submitted it, don’t panic. First, contact your study centre. Provide them your details and ask if they forwarded the marks for your enrollment. Sometimes there is a backlog or delay. If the study centre confirms they sent the marks but it’s not in the system, you may need to contact your Regional Centre with proof of submission (like your receipt). They can follow up with the evaluation division. In many cases, marks get updated just a bit late, so patience is key. However, do inquire if it’s taking excessively long.
  • If Assignment is Rejected or Not Accepted: There are a few reasons an assignment might be rejected: if it was submitted past the deadline without extension, if it was not handwritten (violating guidelines), or if it was found plagiarized/copied. In such cases, typically you would receive a zero or no marks, and you’d have to re-submit in the next cycle. If you suspect your assignment was rejected (for instance, you get a remark or your grade card shows 0 or blank despite timely submission), contact the study centre tutor to understand what went wrong. They might allow you to submit a fresh assignment if timing permits or advise you to submit for the next session. Avoid plagiarism and follow the format rules to prevent this scenario.
  • Keep Proofs: Always keep the acknowledgement receipt (for offline) or email confirmations (for online) until you see the assignment marks in your grade card. That is your evidence in case any issue needs to be escalated.
  • Assignment Feedback: In some cases, tutors write feedback or comments on your answer sheets. If you collect your evaluated assignment later from the study centre, you can see their remarks and learn from any mistakes. This isn’t directly part of submission, but it’s a good practice to review it if available, as it can help you improve in future assignments or exams.

By diligently following up, you can ensure that your hard work is recorded and counted. If you find the assignment marks not reflecting even after results, do the above steps promptly so that any correction can be made in time.

Tips for a Smooth IGNOU Assignment Submission

To conclude the process, here are some additional tips and best practices for a hassle-free submission experience:

  • Start Early: Begin working on your assignments well ahead of the deadline. IGNOU assignments often require writing in your own words, which can be time-consuming. Starting early means you can research properly, write without rushing, and even revise your answers for quality.
  • Follow All Guidelines: Little details matter – use the recommended paper, include the cover page details, don’t exceed recommended word limits by too much, and ensure your content is original. Following these IGNOU assignment instructions will keep you safe from any technical rejection.
  • Stay Updated with Notifications: IGNOU may update processes from time to time (for example, switching from email submission to an online portal). Regularly check IGNOU’s official website or your regional centre’s announcements for any changes in the assignment submission process or deadlines for the current session.
  • Submit in Correct Session: Make sure you submit the assignment for the session you are enrolled in. For instance, if you took admission in January 2025, you must submit assignments for the January 2025 session before the June 2025 exams. Submitting an assignment in the wrong session or after the exam is not valid. If you skip a TEE and plan to appear later, you may need to submit fresh assignments as per the new session’s questions.
  • Course Codes and Programs: The process described applies universally to all programs – IGNOU BA assignment submission, MA assignment submission, B.Com, M.Com, MBA, B.Ed, etc. There might be minor differences (like some programs may have project work in addition to assignments, or specific instructions for certain courses), but generally the assignment formatting and submission route are consistent across disciplines. Always use the correct course code and assignment code given in your program’s assignment booklet to avoid confusion.
  • Ask for Help if Needed: If you are unsure about any step, reach out to your study centre counselors or peers. It’s better to clarify doubts (for example, “How to submit IGNOU assignment for my program?” or “Do I send it via email or hard copy?”) beforehand rather than make a mistake. IGNOU staff are usually helpful in guiding students for assignment submissions.

By following these tips and the guidelines above, you will be well-prepared to submit your IGNOU assignments without any issues.

Must Read: IGNOU Solved Assignment

FAQs in IGNOU Assignment Submission

How do I submit IGNOU assignments online?

Check your Regional Centre’s instructions for online submission. Usually, you need to scan your handwritten assignment into PDF and upload it via a provided Google Form, online portal, or email it to the designated address as per guidelines.

Where do I submit my IGNOU assignment offline?

Offline assignments are submitted at your allotted IGNOU study centre. Prepare your handwritten assignment with the proper cover page and hand it to the coordinator or assignment in-charge there. Always collect a stamped receipt as proof of submission.

What is the last date to submit IGNOU assignments for the June and December exams?

For the June Term-End Exam (TEE), the last date is typically around 31st March for January session students. For the December TEE, it’s usually around 30th September for July session students. These dates may be extended, so check the latest official announcement each session.

Does IGNOU accept typed or printed assignments?

No, IGNOU requires assignments to be handwritten. Typed or printed assignments are generally not accepted and may be rejected. Always write answers in your own handwriting on A4 paper for IGNOU assignment submissions.

What happens if my IGNOU assignment is submitted late?

Late assignments might not be accepted for the current exam session. If you miss the deadline and no extension is given, you may have to submit the assignment in the next semester, delaying your exam and results. Always aim to submit before the deadline.

How can I check my IGNOU assignment submission status or marks?

You can check your assignment marks in the IGNOU Grade Card on the official website after evaluation (usually around the results time). Some regional portals also show status. If your assignment marks are not reflecting even after results are out, contact your study centre or regional centre with proof of submission.

What should be included on the IGNOU assignment cover page?

The cover page of each assignment should include your name, enrollment number, program (course) code, course title & code of the assignment, session (e.g. Jan 2025), your study centre code/name, regional centre, and date of submission. This information helps identify your work correctly.

Can I submit IGNOU assignments by post?

It’s recommended to submit in person at the study centre. However, if you cannot physically go, you may send assignments by post to your study centre’s Coordinator. Make sure to mail well in advance of the deadline and confirm receipt with the centre. Keep postal receipts as proof.

Conclusion

IGNOU assignment submission is a critical task every student must complete each semester. By understanding the IGNOU assignment submission process and following the proper format and deadlines, you can ensure your assignments are accepted and evaluated on time. Always write your assignments diligently in your own words, present them neatly with the required cover page, and submit them via the correct channel (offline at your study centre or online if permitted) before the last date.

Timely and proper submission not only helps you avoid academic penalties but also contributes significantly to your final grade. Keep track of announcements for any changes in procedure or deadline extensions and plan ahead to avoid last-minute rush. With careful preparation and adherence to these guidelines, you can confidently submit your IGNOU assignments and focus on your term-end exams.

Need further assistance or guidance with your IGNOU assignments and projects? Visit ignouproject.com or WhatsApp Us for expert support and resources to help you succeed in your IGNOU journey.

FREQUENTLY

Asked Questions

HOW CAN I CHECK THE STATUS OF MY IGNOU ASSIGNMENT ONLINE?

Begin by visiting the official website at ignou.ac.in. You will be sent to the website of the Indira Gandhi National Open University Assignment Status Check 2021. Choose the Assignment Link. You must supply your enrolment number as well as the course’s programme code.

IS IT POSSIBLE TO SUBMIT IGNOU ASSIGNMENTS AFTER THE DEADLINE?

If you miss the submission date for your assignment, you may still be able to submit it late. However, this may result in a late fee for the related Term End Exam. If you send in your work but do not pass an exam, you may repeat it in any subsequent semester.

HOW CAN I FIND OUT THE LAST DATE FOR IGNOU ASSIGNMENT SUBMISSION?

On the IGNOU website, the university announces assignment submission deadlines for all programmes. On a frequent basis, check the website for updates: http://www.ignou.ac.in/

WHAT ARE THE MOST RECENT IGNOU ASSIGNMENTS?

Current assignments may always be found on the IGNOU website in the Student Zone: http://www.ignou.ac.in/ignou/studentzone.

Assignments are also provided on the WGS boards dedicated to these programmes. Always look for and submit new assignments for the current school year. When new assignments are posted, the old ones become invalid.

WHERE DO I SEND MY IGNOU ASSIGNMENTS?

Submit assignments to your Study Centre/Regional Centre in accordance with the criteria of the Regional Centre. Provide your contact details on assignments (programme code, course code, enrollment number, email, phone).

Send handwritten, signed assignments to the address indicated if your Regional Centre states that only physical copies will be accepted. If soft copies are permitted in extraordinary circumstances such as Covid 19, they must be signed and scanned. Please email your assignments to sogds@ignou.ac.in if you have chosen SOGDS as your RC.

Assignments for each course must be submitted as a single document. Separate pages should not be submitted, nor should homework from two classes be combined in a single document.

WHAT HAPPENS IF I FIND PLAGIARIZED CONTENT IN MY IGNOU ASSIGNMENT?

Plagiarism will not be tolerated or noted, and you will be forced to redo the work. Before submitting assignments, please read the plagiarism standards in your Programme Guide.

ARE IGNOU ASSIGNMENTS REQUIRED TO BE HANDWRITTEN AND SIGNED, OR CAN THEY BE TYPED?

Assignments must be handwritten and signed. They are unable to be typed.

WHAT SHOULD I DO IF I MISS AN IGNOU ASSIGNMENT OR TEST THIS SEMESTER?

If you miss the submission date for your assignment, you may still be able to submit it late. However, this may result in a late fee for the related Term End Exam. If you send in your work but do not pass an exam, you may repeat it in any subsequent semester.

WHAT SHOULD I DO IF I DIDN'T SUBMIT ANY IGNOU ASSIGNMENTS OR TAKE ANY EXAMS DURING THE LAST SEMESTER?

If you have not submitted assignments or missed tests for a course or courses for which you were registered in a previous semester, you may do so in any subsequent semester as long as you finish the programme within the maximum time permitted. However, rather than attempting prior semester tasks, you must attempt fresh ones for the current semester.

DO I NEED TO RESUBMIT IGNOU ASSIGNMENTS IF I HAVEN'T COMPLETED A COURSE?

No, after a course assignment has been received and approved, it does not need to be resubmitted, even if you did not take the final exam at the conclusion of the semester. Your grades on assignments will be kept.

CAN WE COMPLETE OUR IGNOU ASSIGNMENTS ONLINE?

Using the link provided, you may submit your annual assignment online. You can use the university’s online submission methods to submit your assignment from home. Because it is a National Open University, hundreds of young people attend this institution each year.

WHAT IS THE TITLE OF THE IGNOU ASSIGNMENT'S FIRST PAGE?

The first page must provide the following information.

  •  
  • The number on the roll.
  •  
  • The number allocated to you.
  • The title of the course
  • The Research Center.
  •  
  • The deadline for submission.
DO WE NEED TO WRITE QUESTIONS IN OUR IGNOU ASSIGNMENT?

Write each question before creating an answer to prevent having to attach a question paper when submitting the task. After you have completed your assignment writing, keep all of your assignments in a paper file.

ABOUT HOW MANY PAGES SHOULD AN IGNOU ASSIGNMENT CONTAIN?

In most cases, your assignment will state the number of words or pages you must generate. This is usually expressed as a range rather than a single number (for example, 2500–3000 words or 10–12 pages). If you are doubtful, always ask your teacher.

WHAT KIND OF PAPER DOES THE IGNOU ASSIGNMENT REQUIRE?

Students at Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU) can write their coursework on any blank piece of paper. The university, on the other hand, has encouraged students to follow extra standards while completing tasks. “Any plain paper will do.”

CAN I COMPLETE IGNOU ASSIGNMENTS USING IGNOU HELP BOOKS?

Students, according to IGNOU, can write their assignments in a notebook. According to the Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU), students can write their assignments in a notebook on plain paper, scan them, and email them to their respective Regional Centres.

CAN I COPY AND PASTE ASSIGNMENTS FROM IGNOU?

NO COPYING AND PASTEING: Always write your answers from your own ideas; even if you’ve seen the solution somewhere else, don’t just copy and paste it; instead, keep the answer in your own mind.

IS IT ALLOWED TO COPY IGNOU ASSIGNMENTS FROM IGNOU STUDY MATERIAL?

IGNOU students often receive a copy of their assignments along with their study materials. However, people should not be alarmed if they do not obtain the copy for any reason. They can make a request at their study centre. Aside from that, users can obtain a copy through the official website of IGNOU.

IS IT POSSIBLE TO GET IGNOU SOLVED ASSIGNMENTS?

Every assignment available on this page has been completed. It is useful for all students who are needed to submit assignments to the IGNOU study centre in order to take the upcoming TEE Examination.

WHERE CAN I GET FREE IGNOU ASSIGNMENT ANSWERS?

IGNOU solved assignments are available on the Internet or via our website, which sells actual copies of assignments. Except for assignment issues, you may initially be unable to find solved assignments on the internet. You will, however, ultimately be able to access them for free.

IGNOU ASSIGNMENTS ARE CHECKED IN WHAT MANNER?

Counsellors at the Study Centre (SC) go through IGNOU assignments. Following that, they send all of the markings, along with other information such as your enrollment number, SC code, and so on, to your Regional Centre (under which your SC operates). Counselors also attend courses in their respective fields, and as they will be assessing your work at the end, they may assist you with tips/suggestions on assignment writing.

ignoustudymaterial.faq:
Some Important Questions

How can I obtain study materials for IGNOU?

Students can access and download IGNOU Study Material for free on the University’s website (www.ignou.ac.in). To begin, create an account at http://www.egyankosh.ac.in/registration in order to access/download IGNOU Study Material.

Are IGNOU Books available for free?

IGNOU University provides printed study materials to all enrolled students, and the cost is included in the entry fee.

Is the IGNOU Study Material reliable?

IGNOU Study notes are extremely popular among IAS candidates because to its substance, quality, authenticity, affordability, and superior depth of knowledge. It may be quite valuable in IAS elective classes such as (History, Sociology, and so on), and if studied strategically, it will surely boost your comprehension.

How quickly can I obtain IGNOU Study Material?

It can last between 15 to 55 days, and in exceptional instances, it may last longer.

What is an IGNOU Distance Education Course?

Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU) provides its students certificates, undergraduate and postgraduate degrees, as well as postgraduate distance learning courses. IGNOU has approximately 4 million enrolled students and is the largest distance learning open university in the country.

What is the meaning of E-Gyankosh?

E-Gyankosh is a national repository for open and distance learning institutions’ digital learning resources.

Is IGNOU a difficult examination to pass?

We cannot deny that passing the IGNOU exam is challenging, but it is not impossible. Due to the rigorous nature of IGNOU’s grading process, many students question whether passing this examination will be tough.

Do IGNOU offers placement opportunities?

Yes. IGNOU has its own placement unit, which is referred to as the CPC. The cell conducts on-campus and off-campus placement and employability development programmes at its headquarters and regional centres.

Are IGNOU students hired?

Yes. The IGNOU Campus Placement Cell (CPC) was established in 2005 at the university’s headquarters to act as a nodal point for all placement-related activities and to facilitate the process of gainful employment for the university’s diverse and dispersed learner population located throughout the country.

Is IGNOU a failure in terms of assignment?

To pass the IGNOU Assignments, candidates must get a minimum of 40 points out of a potential 100. The minimum marks required for all IGNOU academic programmes would be the same. If a candidate does not get the requisite minimum marks on an IGNOU assignment, the assignment must be resubmitted to IGNOU.

How can I select a subject for my IGNOU project work?

You may choose your own topic from the list of suggested topics provided in the IGNOU Project Handbook/Guidelines, or you may choose any issue pertinent to the curriculum you studied.

Is it possible for me to pick my own supervisor for IGNOU project work?

No, supervisors are chosen by the academics of the institution based on their areas of expertise. After a supervisor has been assigned and your IGNOU Proposal has been accepted, you can begin your IGNOU Project.

Some General Questions

Are IGNOU Assignments consistent year after year?

IGNOU publishes assignments on its website https://webservices.ignou.ac.in/assignments/ each year. For both the JULY and JANUARY entrance sessions, work for one session assignments is submitted. JULY SESSION denotes the start of your course in July. The term JANUARY SESSION refers to the start of your course in January.

Is it possible to take an IGNOU test without submitting an IGNOU assignment?

If you have not submitted IGNOU assignments or missed tests for a course/s for which you were registered in a previous semester, you may do so in any subsequent semester as long as the programme is completed within the maximum term permitted.

Will I receive printed copies of the IGNOU Study Guide?

You will receive actual copies of IGNOU Study Materials only if you specifically request them during registration. If you are experiencing difficulties getting IGNOU Study Materials, please contact mpdd@ignou.ac.in.

How can I find out the deadlines for IGNOU Assignment submissions?

On the IGNOU website, the university announces IGNOU Assignment submission dates for all programmes. Regularly check the webpage for updates: http://www.ignou.ac.in/

What is the procedure for submitting IGNOU assignments?

Submit IGNOU Solved Assignments to your Study Centre/Regional Centre according to the rules established by the Regional Centre. Provide your contact details on IGNOU Solved Assignments (programme code, course code, enrollment number, email, phone).

If your Regional Centre states that only handwritten, signed assignments will be accepted, submit them to the address given. If soft copies are permitted in extraordinary circumstances such as Covid 19, they must be signed and scanned. Send your assignments to sogds@ignou.ac.in if you chose SOGDS as your RC.

IGNOU assignments must be submitted as a single document for each course. Do not submit separate pages or combine homework assignments from two different classes in the same document.

Are IGNOU assignments need to be typed or may they be handwritten and signed?

Assignments must be handwritten and signed. They cannot be typed.

What should I do if I miss an IGNOU Assignment or IGNOU Exam during the current semester?

If you miss the submission deadline/last date for your IGNOU assignment, you may still submit it late. This, however, may result in a late fee for the Term End Exam linked with it. If you submit your work but do not pass an exam, you may repeat it during a subsequent semester.

What should I do if I have not submitted IGNOU assignments or attended for IGNOU exams in a prior semester?

If you have not submitted assignments or failed to appear for examinations for a course/s for which you were registered in a previous semester, you may do so in any subsequent semester as long as you finish the programme within the maximum term permitted. However, you must attempt fresh semester assignments rather than past semester tasks.

Is it necessary for me to re-submit IGNOU assignments if I have not completed a course?

No, once an IGNOU assignment has been received and reviewed for a course, it does not need to be resubmitted, even if you did not take the end-of-semester test. Your grades on IGNOU assignments will be preserved.

How do I pay the IGNOU test fee?

Exam costs for IGNOU are payable online through the IGNOU website.

How do I write the Internship Report for IGNOU?

Your IGNOU internship report should include information on the organisation, your activities during the internship, and the lessons you learned through field experience, particularly in light of the theory covered in class.
